games.description: A solo journey through surreal nightmares. Sark gathers the rulers’ eyes, clears the knowledge and beauty realms, struggles with the big-head nightmare’s many keys, and explores the final choices and another ending.
games.title: Amygdala

games.description: A solo prologue that repeatedly stalls on its interaction puzzles. Sark explores the journalist’s house and abandoned building, learns the nested chase game, retries after a hotfix, and returns with a walkthrough to cut the wires, burn the picture, install the button, and finally escape.
games.title: FourPoint: Prologue

games.description: Sark searches a taxidermy museum for anomalies and repeatedly loses his streak to subtle display changes. Larger creature appearances and careful baseline checks eventually carry him through all thirteen walks to the exit.
